reviewed_by: Claude Code, after an independent subagent review of the roller (7 findings, fixed with regression tests) and a scratch-Core rehearsal
reason: Adds the in-Core project roller (runtime_project_roller.py), a compare-and-cancel withdraw_handoff and roll status in DeploymentCoordinator.status, and lets auto-admission ignore targets of unfinished handoffs. Selected: test_runtime_project_roller.py (new; K-parallel roll, retire after verify, pinned skip/withdraw/retry, held limit, restart mid-roll, operator deferral, withdraw racing transfer, prepare backoff, ledger steps and authenticated status; SQLite and PostgreSQL), test_admission_retry.py (auto-admission, plus the new handoff-target case), test_deployment_lifecycle.py (handoff, checkpoint and status the roller builds on), test_runtime_management.py (deployment operations ledger and status receipts; also enables the CI PostgreSQL runtime for the selection).
exclusions: No UI, setting screen or operator chat workflow changed: the roller is configured by Core environment variables and reported only in authenticated /api/v1/deployment/status, which no UI reads, so no frontend, Playwright or settings-assistant change applies. The external deployer (scripts/simulation) is unchanged and its suites are not selected. Process-spawning supervisor suites (test_supervisor.py, test_execution_worker_process.py) do not exercise the roller, which reaches the supervisor only through RuntimeManagement.dispatch (covered by test_runtime_management.py). The real-Core evidence is the scratch-Core rehearsal recorded in docs/validation/rolling-core-releases.md.
